name: NewIconEmu
notes: Stephan Rupprecht's newicon.library 45.0 (27.10.00) matches the local AmigaOS 3.9 media by SHA-256. The catalogue uses the checked BCWB payload. NewIconEmu provides the NewIcons API using icon.library.
The stock installation adds no NewIcons command, preference tool, startup hook or L handler. Shared default icons and application icons keep their system or application ownership.
